input.policyText:
Agent Operations Manual

4.2 Enhanced identity controls
Agents shall inspect a valid identity document and capture a biometric fingerprint for transactions at or above KES 50,000.

6.1 Suspicious activity reporting
The Money Laundering Reporting Officer shall file suspicious agent transaction reports with the Financial Reporting Centre within 24 hours.

8.1 Agent induction
Every newly appointed agent completes induction training before activation.
input.regulationText:
CBK Agent Banking Circular 2026

Section 3.1 Enhanced customer verification
Banks shall ensure agents inspect a valid identity document and capture a biometric fingerprint for transactions above KES 70,000.

Section 3.2 Suspicious transaction reporting
Banks shall report suspicious agent transactions to the Financial Reporting Centre within 24 hours.

Section 3.3 Recurring training
Banks shall ensure every active agent completes KYC and anti-money-laundering refresher training at least once every twelve months.
